channel.title: Vallejo Times Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Vallejo Times Herald (timesheraldonline.com)

item.title: NIH’s Bhattacharya will also run the CDC while Trump administration looks for a permanent director
item.description: Bhattacharya will be the third leader of the embattled CDC during Trump’s second term.

item.title: Prep playoff girls basketball: Bethel hustles to pull away from Del Norte
item.description: The Jesse Bethel High School girls basketball team used an 8-0 fourth-quarter run, buoyed by hard-fought rebounds, defensive effort and steals to pull away from Del Norte and collect a 49-41 victory in Tuesday's playoff opener.

item.title: FDA will drop two-study requirement for new drug approvals, aiming to speed access
item.description: The FDA has generally required new drugs be shown safe and effective in two trials.

item.title: WH adviser Hassett urges ‘discipline’ for Fed economists over tariff study
item.description: Several other studies have reached similar conclusions as the New York Fed.

item.title: Solano County-specific tips for handling the rain
item.description: Driving in the middle lanes optimizes your chance of avoiding the giant puddles that tend to develop in the far left and far right lanes.

item.title: Trump, weeks after backlash over racist post, hosts Black History Month reception
item.description: At the White House reception, Trump name-checked prominent Black Americans among his supporters.

item.title: Blues musician Alvon Johnson to perform at 4th Corner Speakeasy
item.description: “An Evening of Blues and Jazz” will be held Saturday at 4th Corner Speakeasy, 431 Georgia St., Vallejo.

item.title: Hearing to sever murder charges delayed
item.description: If convicted at trial for the killings, Klein — who was convicted of a felony in 2006 in Contra Costa County — faces 50 years to life for the murders and likely more time for using firearms and being a previously convicted felon, among other enhancements.

item.title: Prep girls basketball playoffs: Vanden pours on offense in first-round win
item.description: Next up for No. 5-seeded Vanden is a visit to No. 4 Lincoln in the second round. The last time the two teams met up was in the 2022 Sac-Joaquin Section championship, won by the Vikings at Sacramento's Golden 1 Center.

item.title: Air Force One will be repainted as Trump has hinted, US military says
item.description: A “red, white, gold and dark blue paint scheme” will be used for the jet.
